decision: Review all72 hunks across all14 original example/calendar/datepicker/harness files. They remove MatNativeDateModule/NativeDateModule imports from private fixture scopes, add provideNativeDateAdapter calls to providers, and change the private datepicker createComponent helper/calls and one describe label.
